data.name: Baryram
data.gender_notes: Baryram is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'barys' meaning 'heavy, rich' and the word 'ramnos' meaning 'ram'. This name evokes images of strength and power, reminiscent of the biblical ram sacrificed in place of Abraham's son, Isaac. The name Baryram carries the meaning “Bold, Strong Ram” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Baryram usually hope their child will grow to embody bold, strong ram and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Baryram belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bold, Strong Ram.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Baryram total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
